name: @liftr/plugin-liftr-common
description: Shared Liftr public /v1 API contracts for the Backstage integration: DTO types mirroring docs/openapi/v1/openapi.yaml, a lossless-JSON representation layer, monitor-link validation, opaque idempotency handling, origin validation, Problem sanitization, and delegation subject binding. Framework-free and free of any server implementation imports by design.
